assertion: Plain nested Kwargs and Slots declarations on a concrete Component become slotted dataclass schemas; fields without defaults are required and fields with defaults are optional.
prerequisites: A concrete Component subclass using plain nested schema classes.
supported_context: Current Python package and supported plain-schema adapter.
successful_outcome: The generated schemas expose the declared fields through attributes and enforce required/default shape.
failure_behavior: A missing required field or unexpected field raises TypeError when inputs are finalized.
notes: The tutorial demonstrates one required field in each schema.

assertion: Annotations on a plain Kwargs or Slots schema describe intended Python types but do not validate runtime value types.
prerequisites: A plain nested schema rather than a validating adapter.
security_implications: Do not rely on annotations alone at an untrusted input boundary.
successful_outcome: A statically correct value flows through the declared field and renders.
failure_behavior: A wrong-type value may be accepted; use a validating adapter when runtime type rejection is required.
notes: The recipe intentionally verifies numeric accent data is accepted structurally.

assertion: Calling a Component class composes a CitryElement; rendering and input validation occur when render() or str() is called.
prerequisites: A component class owned by a Citry instance.
successful_outcome: The call returns CitryElement and str(element) returns serialized HTML.
failure_behavior: Input-shape and render errors surface during render or serialization rather than composition.

assertion: Component.template_data() returns kwargs by default, so a matching Kwargs field is available to the template without an override.
prerequisites: The template variable name matches the Kwargs field and no custom mapping is needed.
security_implications: Template variables remain server-side unless explicitly passed to browser data APIs.
successful_outcome: The template resolves a declared input with no template_data override.
failure_behavior: An override replaces the default mapping and must return every variable its template needs.
notes: This implementation detail is intentionally kept out of the first Card tutorial because the reader does not need it to complete the task.

assertion: A declared Kwargs schema rejects missing and unexpected field names when a directly composed element renders.
prerequisites: A closed declared Kwargs schema and direct Python composition.
security_implications: Field-name rejection reduces accidental undeclared input, but does not validate value trust.
successful_outcome: Every required field is present and no unexpected field reaches the component.
failure_behavior: Missing or unexpected fields raise a wrapped TypeError during render.

assertion: Python callers pass slot fills through slots={...}; values normalize to Slot objects, and a Slots field without a default is required.
prerequisites: The slot key matches a field in the declared Slots schema.
supported_context: Direct Python composition and template-authored fills.
security_implications: Plain string slot content is HTML-escaped when normalized.
successful_outcome: The default fill renders at the component's c-slot outlet.
failure_behavior: A missing required schema field or unknown slot name raises TypeError during render.
notes: Schema-required supply is distinct from the required attribute on an outlet.

assertion: A statically authored component tag is checked against registered Kwargs and Slots rules when its parent template is first compiled.
prerequisites: The child is registered before the parent template's lazy first compile and names are statically knowable.
supported_context: Static component attributes and fills in Citry templates.
security_implications: Early shape checks reduce accidental undeclared inputs; dynamic spreads defer relevant checks.
successful_outcome: The CardPage template compiles with one accent and one default body fill.
failure_behavior: A missing required static input or fill raises SyntaxError during lazy template compilation.
notes: The minimal tutorial uses Python for failure examples and links to the detailed validation explanation.

assertion: Values returned from css_data() become CSS custom properties selected by a data-ccss hash marker on that rendered component's root elements.
prerequisites: The component has nonblank CSS and returns nonempty valid CSS data.
supported_context: Default dependencies extension in documents and supported fragments.
security_implications: CSS data keys and values pass structural containment checks before emission.
successful_outcome: Two accents produce distinct marker hashes and each card resolves its own --accent value.
failure_behavior: Invalid CSS data raises during dependency collection; no nonblank component CSS means the data is not delivered.
notes: This is the shipped instance-scoped behavior used by the pilot.

assertion: Default document serialization places collected component CSS at c-css, otherwise before the document head closes, otherwise before the rendered markup.
prerequisites: A render carries component CSS and dependency serialization is not ignore.
supported_context: Default document strategy with smart placement.
security_implications: Generated style content applies under the normal browser CSS trust boundary.
successful_outcome: The complete CardPage places styles in its head at c-css; a standalone Card string begins with styles.
failure_behavior: The ignore strategy suppresses assets; absent placement tags use documented fallback positions.
notes: The tutorial's abridged output includes the standalone placement shape.
